_comment: 上游來源授權基準。check_upstream.py 以此比對；人工確認變更後更新對應欄位與 last_verified。

sources.name: stamparm/maltrail data/mass_scanner.txt
sources.obligations: Keep MIT copyright + permission notice (scripts/gen_mass_scanner.py MALTRAIL_NOTICE)
sources.notes: data/ is excluded from the Trails data license (Trails license §1.2(e)). Threat data moved to stamparm/trails in 2026.

sources.name: stamparm/trails
sources.obligations: Must NOT appear in rsc/, Releases or workflows. Redistribution/feeds need written permission (sales@sekuripy.hr). Pre-existing MIT material up to commit e7d704c8 stays MIT; items become CC BY 4.0 three years after publication.

sources.name: Emerging Threats fwrules
header_patterns: Redistribution and use in source and binary forms
sources.obligations: Keep BSD copyright, conditions and disclaimer (copied by gen_blocklists.py extract_upstream_header)

sources.name: Spamhaus DROP / DROPv6
sources.obligations: Name Spamhaus as source, keep copyright line and timestamps at top of file, auto-fetch at most once per hour, no Spamhaus name in marketing. Text feeds may be deprecated in favour of JSON.

sources.name: ipv64.net blocklists
sources.obligations: No license or terms found (site returns 403 to automated fetches). README marks it 'Not published'.

sources.name: RIPEstat announced-prefixes
sources.obligations: Send sourceapp=sinnoken-routeros-rsc; max 8 concurrent requests per IP; owner to register sourceapp with stat@ripe.net.

sources.name: University of Oregon Route Views (via pyasn)
sources.obligations: Terms of Route Views and CIDR Report (AS names) not yet verified. pyasn itself is MIT.
